# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY, First Job Rs.15,000)
Ministry of Labour & Employment, through EPFO

A one-time payment of up to Rs.15,000 for people in their first PF-covered job: anyone who joins an EPFO-registered employer between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027, has never had PF deducted before, and earns up to Rs.1 lakh a month. There is no application form; the money comes from your employer's monthly PF filing, but only if your UAN was made with face authentication on the UMANG app and your bank account is seeded with Aadhaar. Half is paid after 6 months of work, and the rest after 12 months and a short online financial literacy course, kept in a savings deposit for a fixed period. It was announced in Budget 2024-25 as the Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) scheme.

Get your bank account seeded with Aadhaar for DBT at your branch. Without it the payment waits, though it keeps adding up.
Your employer files PF every month. Check in UMANG or on the EPFO member portal that your contributions are showing.
After 6 completed months with the same employer, the first instalment, half of one month's PF wage up to Rs.7,500, comes to your Aadhaar-seeded account.
Finish the free online financial literacy course on the EPFO portal before your 12th month.
After 12 completed months, the second instalment (the rest, total up to Rs.15,000) is put into a savings deposit in your name, to be paid out later.

Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

A guaranteed pension of Rs.1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 a month from age 60, for anyone aged 18 to 40 who has a savings account and does not pay income tax. You choose the pension, and a fixed amount is auto-debited from your bank account until you turn 60; the younger you join, the less you pay. After you, your husband or wife gets the same pension, and after both of you the nominee gets the saved amount. The Cabinet extended the scheme up to 2030-31 in January 2026; you can join online on eAPY if your bank is listed there, through your bank's net banking, or at your bank or post office branch.
